description: Extends ThePhaseless/renovate-config, a public repository (checked 2026-11-25). It groups minor, patch and digest updates and automerges them; the rules below turn automerge off for what ends up in the images or CI.

customManagers.description: Upstream releases in Dockerfiles, built by the tag's commit: ARG X=<sha> # renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=<owner/repo> currentValue=<tag>
Untagged retrofit apps pinned to a branch commit: ARG X=<sha> # renovate: datasource=git-refs depName=<git url> currentValue=master

packageRules.description: Actions, Dockerfile base images and upstream pins change what CI runs and what the images contain: review every update. Their own group, so the preset's automerged group keeps automerging dev tooling.
packageRules.groupName: CI actions, base images and upstreams

packageRules.description: Go toolchain: mise.toml and the golang images move together
Bun: mise.toml, the oven/bun image and @types/bun move together
go-mfp is pinned to a commit and has no releases; review every bump
The HPLIP plug-in must match the hplip version in the driver image
prBodyNotes: Bumping hplip in images/driver/Dockerfile also requires bumping the hplip-plugin EULA version, the blob version and the blob URL in internal/catalog/catalog.yaml, and replacing the blob's verify sha256 there with the new plug-in's (check the download against its .asc signature first).
